summary_1line: Dhritarashtra laments destiny despite his vast army, while Bhima rampages through Kaurava ranks and Dhrishtadyumna rescues and joins him amid intense battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima leaps from his chariot with mace in hand and charges alone into the dense Kaurava army, crushing elephants and warriors.
Dhrishtadyumna finds Bhima wounded and raging on foot amid heaps of fallen warriors and lifts him onto his chariot in the middle of battle.
The Kaurava princes collapse senseless across the battlefield after Dhrishtadyumna releases the mystical Pramohana weapon.
